observation: Front-desk check-in: Meera types while Mr. Raman, cane in his right hand, smiles at her across the counter. Inspected at 25% (contact sheet), 100% (full panel) and 200% (face crops), and on the composed page.

anatomy.note: Raman leans with his left hand flat on the counter and right hand on the cane head; Meera types with both hands, wrists natural.

contact.note: Cane tip on the floor; Meera's fingers on the keyboard.

objects.note: Monitor faces Meera; TV shows only a blank strip; QR stand abstract; vitals cart in the background; no text.

faces.note: Faces match the sheets at 200%; see faceIdentity.

linework.note: Clean contours and flat cel shading consistent with the earlier pages.

background.note: Glass entrance, waiting chairs and vitals cart sketched simply; edit (background) recoloured the two seated patients grey and dark brown so none reads as Ravi.

continuity.note: Meera's braid over her left shoulder and bangle on the right wrist match the sheet; Raman matches the check-in patients sheet.

lettering.note: Caption in the white top-left band; its bottom clears the top of Raman's hair.
